newsitem.title: UK: Thin inquiry for raw cotton in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Thin inquiry for raw cotton in Europe.

text.p: European markets generally saw thin inquiry for raw cotton.

But comeptitive nearby-shipment offers of Syrian, Central Asian and African franc zone medium/better qualities were being kept under close review especially in Portugal, Italy and Belgium where traders say there may have been some modest sales.
Eastern Europe was also rather slow but routine price-testing inquirties were noted in Poland. The long staple sector lacked feature.
